title: Does anyone play your town?
excerpt: Volunteers have documented 7,615 UK concerts in MusicBrainz. I mapped every one by council area. 70 of 167 big council areas have no documented tour date, and arena towns hold 53% of them.
seo_description: Every UK concert documented in MusicBrainz, 1960 to 2025, mapped by council area: arena towns hold 10% of people but 53% of tour dates.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Does anyone play your town?' beside a map of UK council areas, most shaded blue, with red patches and black arena triangles.
